description: For a limited company owner: what a salary and dividend split leaves after Corporation Tax, NI and personal tax, and the salary that leaves the most. Use for 'what salary should I pay myself from my company'.

companyProfit.description: Profit before any salary, employer NI or Corporation Tax, in pounds a year.

employerPension.description: Employer pension contribution paid by the company. Defaults to 0.

otherIncome.description: Other personal taxable income. Defaults to 0.

salary.description: A salary to work out, in pounds a year. Defaults to the one that leaves the most.

name: calculate_salary_vs_dividends
title: Salary vs dividends
